description: Source code for WASAPI audio sink implementation for UWP platform, handling audio device initialization, buffer management, playback control, and volume adjustment.

classes.name: WASAPIAudioSink
classes.description: Class managing WASAPI audio output, including device setup, buffer writing, playback control, and volume management.

methods.name: WASAPIAudioSink
methods.description: Constructor initializing device and audio client.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up audio device and buffer with specified channels, sample rate, and codec.

methods.name: WriteBuffer
methods.description: Queues decoded audio data for playback.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the audio sink, stopping playback and clearing buffers.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate (unsupported rates are checked).

methods.name: GetCurrentPlaybackTime
methods.description: Returns current playback position in microseconds.

methods.name: OutputFrames
methods.description: Handles buffer filling and scheduling of audio frames for playback.

methods.name: UpdatePlaybackState
methods.description: Updates playback state, including starting/stopping device and setting volume.
